# Deepriton

**Deepriton** is a жидкая (непрерывная откачка) ore. Each extraction yields **450** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/ru/formats/ore-fields/).

## Добыча

| Property | Значение |
|---|---|
| Количество за цикл | 450 |
| Тип добычи | жидкая (непрерывная откачка) |
| Требуемый эффект | не требуется |
| Документ геосканирования | definition 8699 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
